title: 第7章 劫狱第8章 带薪休假
content_zh:
《天禅宝功》，罗敬天教给陈观楼的内功心法，绝不是街边随处可见的大路货，算得上中等品级的内功心法。
白天在家，陈观楼尝试修炼内功。
果不其然，没有武脉的他，很快就尝到了苦头，不仅毫无进展，且浑身痛苦。尤其是五脏六腑，感觉被一股力量挤压，仿佛下一秒就要爆炸。
好在，他身负长生道果，只要还有一口气在，长生道果转眼间就修复好他的身体。否则，他就要因为强行修炼内功心法而身负重伤。
尝试过后，他念头越发通达，更加坚定了修炼内功心法的决心。别人不能练，他凭借长生道果不惧寿元损害，不惧腹脏重伤，完全可以横推强行修炼。
自此，他就开始了上班当差摸鱼，下班练功的生活。
想到自己长生不老，怕他日忘了今时今日，好记性不如烂笔头，他决定写日记。
大乾泰兴四十五年，四月十八，天晴。
卢大头赌输了，找我借钱。我一个穷光蛋哪有钱借给他。只请他吃了一碗牛肉面。
泰兴四十五年，四月二十五，小雨。
听说许富贵同张狱吏不和，两人正在蒋狱丞跟前别矛头。
泰兴四十五年，四月二十八，阴天。
我见到了抢我萝卜坑的王八蛋，万狱吏，管着甲子号大牢，油水最足的大牢，里面关押的都是犯官。他显然也认出了我。身为后来者，却后来居上管着甲子号大牢，显然背景深厚，暂时惹不起。以后躲着他。待老子……
泰兴四十五年，五月初一，天晴。
大吉大利，今日发薪水。月俸二两，奖金八两。这份铁饭碗，我端定了。天王老子来了，我也要端牢这碗饭。
当庆贺，晚上勾栏听曲！
泰兴四十五年，五月初二，小雨。
置办了一份礼物，给苏家送去。苏老婆子一如既往势利眼，难得对我露出笑脸，对大姐也是少见的和颜悦色。
只要苏老婆子不苛待大姐，大不了以后多送点礼。
泰兴四十五年，五月初三，阴雨天。

到刘家送礼，很可惜没能见到刘万氏。丫鬟秀娟怪好的，就是坏习惯太多，喜欢动手动脚。
泰兴四十五年，五月初十，阴天。
蒋狱丞罕见的来到天牢巡查，不太寻常。
泰兴四十五年，五月十二。
夜班，摸鱼。
泰兴四十五年，五月十四。
夜班，继续摸鱼。左眼跳财右眼跳灾，右眼跳个不停，感觉不太好。
泰兴四十五年，五月十八，小雨。
卧槽！
夜班巡视，陈观楼提着水火棍，独自一人在丙子号大牢巡视，清点人数，确定死活，以防万一。
这份差事，他已经做熟了。除了几个新关进来的犯人，其他都是老熟人。只是，十三号房的犯人，至今他还没见到真面目。
从头到尾巡视一遍，准备回值房睡觉。
走到半途，他突然停下脚步。
安静！
content_en:
"Tianchan Baogong", the inner strength and mental method taught by Luo Jingtian to Chen Guanlou, is by no means a popular commodity that can be seen everywhere on the street. It can be regarded as a mid-level inner strength and mental method.
At home during the day, Chen Guanlou tried to practice internal skills.
As expected, without martial arts, he soon experienced the pain. Not only did he make no progress, but he was also in pain all over. Especially the internal organs, it feels like it is being squeezed by a force, as if it is about to explode in the next second.
Fortunately, he was carrying the Fruit of Immortality. As long as he still had breath, the Fruit of Immortality would repair his body in the blink of an eye. Otherwise, he would be seriously injured due to the forced practice of inner skills and mental methods.
After trying it, his thoughts became clearer and he became more determined to practice inner strength and mental methods. Others cannot practice, but he is not afraid of damage to his lifespan and serious abdominal injuries by virtue of the Immortality Dao Fruit, and he can completely push and practice forcefully.
Since then, he has started a life of fishing at work and practicing martial arts after get off work.
Thinking of his immortality and fearing that he would forget the present day and have a good memory rather than a bad writing, he decided to write a diary.
In the forty-fifth year of the Taixing Period of the Great Qian Dynasty, on April 18th, the sky was sunny.
Lu Datou lost his bet and asked me to borrow money. How could I, a pauper, have the money to lend him money? I only treated him to a bowl of beef noodles.
Forty-five years ago in Taixing, April 25th, it rained lightly.
I heard that Xu Fugui was at odds with Prisoner Zhang, and the two were arguing in front of Jiang Yucheng.
In the forty-fifth year of Taixing, April 28th, it was cloudy.
I saw the bastard who robbed me of my carrot pit, Warden Wan, who was in charge of Jia Zi Prison, the most lucrative prison, where all prisoners were detained. He obviously recognized me too. As a latecomer, but he came from behind to take charge of the Jiazi prison, he obviously has a deep background and cannot be offended for the time being. Avoid him from now on. Wait for me...
In the forty-fifth year of Taixing, on the first day of May, the sky was sunny.
Good luck, paycheck will be paid today. The monthly salary is 20 taels and the bonus is 8 taels. I've secured this iron rice bowl. The King of Heaven is here, and I have to hold on to this bowl of rice.
When celebrating, listen to music at night!
In the forty-fifth year of Taixing, on the second day of May, it rained lightly.
I bought a gift and sent it to the Su family. Mrs. Su was as snobbish as ever. She rarely smiled at me, and was also rarely kind to my eldest sister.
As long as Mrs. Su treats her eldest sister seriously, she can give her more gifts in the future.
In the forty-fifth year of Taixing, it was a rainy day on the third day of May.
I went to Liu's house to give gifts, but it was a pity that I couldn't meet Liu Wanshi. The maid Xiujuan is very good, but she has too many bad habits and likes to use her hands and feet.
In the forty-fifth year of Taixing, it was a cloudy day on the tenth day of May.
Jiang Yucheng rarely came to Tianlao for inspection, which was unusual.
Forty-five years of Taixing, May 12th.
Night shift, fishing.
Forty-five years of Taixing, May 14th.
Night shift, continue fishing. The left eye jumps for money and the right eye jumps for disaster. The right eye jumps non-stop, which doesn't feel good.
Forty-five years ago in Taixing, on May 18th, it rained lightly.
Damn it!
During the night shift inspection, Chen Guanlou, carrying a water and fire stick, patrolled the cell of No. Bingzi alone, counting the number of people and determining whether they were alive or dead, just in case.
He's already done this job. Except for a few newly admitted prisoners, the others are all old acquaintances. However, he has not yet seen the true face of the prisoner in Room 13.
Check it from beginning to end and prepare to go back to the value room to sleep.
Halfway through, he suddenly stopped.
Quiet!
